Can you elaborate what you mean by shuffle and mutate ? changing the randao enough so that the sync committee shuffling changes But thats fixed during an sync comittee period then the next sync committees would differ across forks right, so then the "next next" Let me explain my protocol again. Lets assume I am a light client and I have a finalised slot n. There was a very low participation rate during the current sync committee period and the next sync committee period. Now I would like to verify the next to next sync committee. A node can give me set of blocks from the next sync committee period and I can check if it has aggregated unique 2/3 signatures pointing to the same next to next sync committee. Once I have that I can be certain about the next next sync committee
